Class TurLoggingToolService

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.tool.TurLoggingToolService
@Service public class TurLoggingToolService extends Object
Tool calling service for log analysis via LLM. Provides tools to query server, indexing, and AEM logs stored in MongoDB.
